analytical_qualifications.R116_is_not_an_open_circuit: 100k emitter return bypasses Q42 weakly; no zero-current proof is claimed
analytical_qualifications.weak_gate_bias_assumptions: Q41 emitter <=3.3V+3%; R116 -1%, R110 +1%; excludes transistor hot leakage/back-power/invalid logic rails
analytical_qualifications.role_counterdrive_assumptions: GPIO2 drives LOW through R71 -1%, role pullup R70 +1%; JP1 open; ordinary 0..VCC GPIO fault only
analytical_qualifications.clear_clock_collision: Async clear release near a clock rising edge must meet HC74 recovery time; Boolean event priority is not physical timing proof

findings.summary: HC74 asynchronous clear fixes restart on stop release during an existing RC arm pulse
Input-side UP controls now have safe unplugged defaults; actual local inhibit forwards downstream
Recovery/reset-pulse widths and asynchronous path skew require physical qualification
R116 weak gate bias is about 0.16V under stated valid-rail assumptions; hot/powered-off coil leakage must be measured
3.3V-powered open-drain supply monitors clear RUN on 5V/12V loss; restoration while ARM is held cannot restart outputs

model_scope.logic: Settled 0/1 gates plus ideal-DC U35 supply-monitor signs, using actual native pin nets and edge-triggered FF asynchronous clear
model_scope.chain: Ideal buffered stages; host NC-loop fault propagates actual OE downstream; a local-only fault stops that board/downstream, not necessarily upstream
not_modeled: unpowered or out-of-range CMOS truth behavior
